_about: Every game here is redistributable under the license listed. Prebuilt .swf files and HTML5 games are fetched by scripts/fetch-games.mjs at build time (they are not committed). Each game's license file is placed next to it. GPL games: source is at the upstream URL. Smoke-test each SWF in Ruffle before shipping a release. 'sidecars' lists extra files a SWF loads at runtime (downloaded next to it). Ruffle is given the SWF's folder as its base URL. 'strategy' is 1 (pure reflex) to 5 (heavy planning); default per-play price is cheaper for higher strategy. Parents can override prices.
_candidates_needing_a_build: Mode, Flappybalt, Flx-Invaders, FlxTeroids (Adam Saltsman, MIT) — AS3 Flixel sources; compile with Apache Flex SDK or the HaxeFlixel ports (lime build flash).
HaxeFlixel demos: Flixius, MinimalistTD, Breakout, FlxSnake (MIT) — lime build flash.
Pirate Pig (OpenFL, MIT) — swap the CC-BY-NC theme song before bundling.
_removed: The bundled open-source HTML5/Flash games were removed (2026-11-05, Luke): the arcade is the Flashpoint classics a parent picks, plus games a parent adds.
